novelty_basis: An elementary consequence of the Guibas-Odlyzko generating function; the resulting count sequences are catalogued as partial sums (OEIS A000071 = Fibonacci(n) - 1, A008937 = partial sums of tribonacci numbers).
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C11.md Theorem 3), skeptic-reviewed 2026-10-18 (reviews/skeptic_C05_C08_C12.md); 0 mismatches with exact integers for all unbordered patterns of length 3..9 up to length 200 (EXP-C11-06); ratios 1.618033989, 1.191487884, 1.078095078 for k = 2, 3, 4 (EXP-C11-02)
statement:
If u is unbordered and |u| = k + 1, the codeword counts of T_u are the partial sums of those of T_(1^k):
f_u(L) = cum_(1^k)(L - 1). Hence lambda_u is the k-bonacci constant lambda and cum_u(L)/cum_(1^k)(L) -> 1/(lambda - 1).
title: Unbordered terminators: F_u = x/(1-x) F_(1^k), so codeword counts are partial sums of the all-ones counts
